# Fair Trade Safaris

> Fair Trade Safaris offers ethical, luxury African safaris that support local communities, protect wildlife, and promote sustainable tourism. Journeys are tailor-made, guided by locals, and committed to giving back. Based in Austin, Texas, USA, serving travellers to East and Southern Africa.

Fair Trade Safaris plans private, small-group and expert-led safaris across Kenya, Tanzania, Botswana, South Africa, Namibia, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Uganda, Rwanda, Mozambique, Madagascar, Seychelles and Mount Kilimanjaro, with beach add-ons such as Zanzibar and Diani. Every itinerary can be customised. Contact the team to plan a trip.

## Safari styles
- [Luxury African Safaris](https://www.fairtradesafaris.com/luxury-african-safaris/): Privately curated luxury safaris, including best time to go
- [Private African Safaris](https://www.fairtradesafaris.com/private-african-safaris/)
- [Small Group African Safaris](https://www.fairtradesafaris.com/small-group-african-safaris/)
- [Expert-Led African Safaris](https://www.fairtradesafaris.com/expert-led-african-safaris/)
- [Golf Safari in South Africa](https://www.fairtradesafaris.com/golfinity-south-africa-safari/)
